propositions: Durable bridge status is written to refs/reconciler/last-pass by a single process finalizer before lock release with exact three-attempt bounded CAS and exponential backoff, replacing duplicate pass-record producers

Canonical rebar bridge status and hidden bridge-status alias expose identical read-only snapshots with total verdict precedence PAUSED > RUNNING > FOREIGN > FAILED > STALE > HEALTHY and explicit REBAR_ENV_ID or derived local:<repo-env-id> identity
Status command is fast read-only and never mutates, calls steal(), or sleeps for lease; canary performs two snapshots across lease to detect stalled fence and classify CRASHED
Canary defaults to durable status source and makes no heartbeat API query on canonical path, with explicit REBAR_CANARY_HEARTBEAT_SOURCE=github-api rollback retained for one release
Missing, empty, or unreadable .env-id is a hard configuration error for writer and status; legacy inbound event metadata and LEGACY_JIRA_ENV_ID remain unchanged

Red-first test oracle proves canonical and legacy parity, all verdicts and exits, no mutation, identity separation, durable success ordering, stalled-fence detection, exact CAS behavior, and canary ref fetch without API query
